rules.checkpoint_id: ASCII [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,95}; the selected checkpoint is never substituted across variants
rules.claims_qualified: must be false; a manifest cannot qualify the candidate
rules.file_checks: absolute regular files; every declared SHA-256 must match the actual bytes; weights byte count must match
rules.framewise_causal: requires zero lookahead and zero offline context
rules.framewise_lookahead: requires positive lookahead and zero offline context
rules.offline_chunked: requires positive offline context, zero lookahead and zero left-context declaration

required_items.requirement: Per-frame probabilities with exact half-open source intervals.
Speech event boundaries and detections with exact sample coordinates.
Separate quiet and active speech strata with matched labels.
Idle noise and nonspeech controls, including false-alarm accounting.
Known-positive and known-negative cases with explicit controls.
Onset and offset boundary error in samples and milliseconds.
Stratified FN/FP and totals computed from real labels.
Known nonspeech is scored; invalid or unknown values never become nonspeech.
Independent per-stream cache and reset for the framewise path.
Every probability and event maps to exact source sample intervals.
Availability, dropped and stale event accounting on the target runtime.
160-sample SDK hop, the candidate frame shift and offline chunking are reconciled explicitly.
